quote: Life is a gift, life is happiness, each minute might have been an age of happiness.
source: Fyodor Dostoevsky, letter to Mikhail, 22 December 1849, Letters and Reminiscences, p. 11 (trans. Koteliansky and Murry, 1923)
note: Corrected the page. In the Chatto and Windus edition of 1923 the letter opens on page 1 and this sentence falls on page 11, not page 6. The wording is exact.

evidence.locator: Letter to his Brother, The Peter and Paul Fortress, December 22, 1849, p. 11

reason: The sentence is verbatim in the Koteliansky and Murry translation, in the letter dated 22 December 1849, under the page 11 running head; the proposal’s page 6 was wrong. Dostoevsky goes to three of three with this line.
